awarenessData.phishingProtectionDesc: Yaaliiwwan gowwoomsaa odeeffannoo dhuunfaa fi ogummaa keessan irratti xiyyeeffatan adda baasuu fi irraa fagaachuu baraa.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Desc: Liinkii cuqaasuu keessan dura mallattoolee beekamoo imeelii gowwoomsaa hubadhaa.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul1: Teessoo ergaa dogoggora qubee ykn doomeenii addaa ta'uu mirkaneeffadhaa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul2: Bakka geessu dursee arguuf cuqaasuu dura liinkii irra turaa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul3: Jechoota ariifachiisaa tarkaanfii battalaa barbaadan of eeggadhaa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul4: Maxxantoota ykn gaaffii buusuu hin beekamne shakkisiisaa ta'an of eeggadhaa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Desc: Liinkota balaafamoo bakka hundatti mul'atan irraa kan isin eegan amaleeffannaa ijaaraa.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Bul1: Liinkii imeelii fayyadamuu mannaa kallattiin gara weebsaayitiitti deemaa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Bul3: Baarii teessoo irratti HTTPS fi maqaa doomeenii sirrii barbaadaa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Bul4: URL shakkiisaa ta'an banuu dura meeshaa qorannoo liinkii fayyadamaa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Desc: Gowwoomsi yeroo isin mudatu tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa fudhachuun warra kaanis miidhaa irraa eega.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul1: Ergaawwan shakkiisaa garee nageenyaa dhaabbata keessaniif beeksisaa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul2: Imeelota gowwoomsaa hiriyoota hojiitiif hin dabarsinaa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul3: Teessoo ergaa sana appilikeeshinii imeelii keessan irratti battalumatti ugguraa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul4: Odeeffannoo galchitanii yoo turtan battalumatti jecha darbii jijjiiraa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Desc: Jecha darbii qofaa caalaa akkaawuntii keessaniif eegumsa dabalataa uumaa.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Bul2: Koodii SMS mannaa appilikeeshinoota mirkaneessaa filadhaa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Bul3: Akkaawuntiiwwan murteessoo ta'aniif furtuuwwan nageenyaa haardweerii fayyadamaa
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Bul4: Koodii 2FA keessan yoo gaafatamtaniyyuu eenyuufiyyuu hin qoodinaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneDesc: Akkaawuntii keessan haleellaa irraa eeguuf jechoota darbii jabaa uumaa fi bulchaa.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Desc: Tilmaamuuf ulfaataa ta'ee garuu yaadachuuf salphaa ta'e uumuu baraa.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul1: Yoo xiqqaate qubeewwan, lakkoofsota fi mallattoolee 12 fi isaa ol fayyadamaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul2: Odeeffannoo dhuunfaa (guyyaa dhalootaa, maqaa) fayyadamuu irraa fagaadhaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul3: Gaalee jechoota wal hin qabannee (passphrases) fayyadamaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul4: Tartiiba gabatee qabduu (kan akka 123456 ykn qwerty) hin fayyadaminaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Desc: Furtuuwwan hunda nagaan olkaa'uuf bulchitoota jecha darbii fayyadamaa.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul1: Akkaawuntii tokkoon tokkoof jecha darbii addaa uumaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul2: Jechoota darbii kitaaba irratti ykn baawuzerii irratti ifatti hin kaa'inaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul3: Jecha darbii ijoo (Master Password) baay'ee jabaa godhaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul4: Bulchaa jecha darbii mirkaneessa sadarkaa lamaan (2FA) eegaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Desc: Jechi darbii keessan yoo hatamellee akkaawuntii keessan eeguuf ittisa dabalataa uumaa.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul1: Akkaawuntiiwwan barbaachisoo hunda irratti mirkaneessa sadarkaa lamaa dandeessisaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul2: SMS caalaa appilikeeshinoota mirkaneessaa (Authenticator Apps) fayyadamaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul3: Koodiiwwan baraarsaa (Backup codes) bakka nageenyi isaa eegametti olkaayaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul4: Koodiin mirkaneessaa hin gaafatamin yoo dhufe battalumatti dammaqaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Desc: Nageenya gaariif jecha darbii yoomii fi akkamitti jijjiiruu akka qabdan beekaa.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul1: Balaan akka ga'e yoo shakkitan battalumatti jecha darbii jijjiiraa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul2: Jecha darbii akkaawuntii qooddamee ji'oottan sadii sadiin jijjiiraa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul3: Yoo dirqama hin taane jechoota darbii deddeebisanii jijjiiruu irraa fagaadhaa
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul4: Jabina jecha darbii keessanii qoruuf meeshaa qorannoo fayyadamaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingDesc: Intarneetii irratti yeroo hojjettan odeeffannoo dhuunfaa fi meeshaa keessan balaa saayibarii irraa eegaa.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Desc: Weebsaayitoonni daawwattan amansiisaa fi iccitiin isaanii eegame ta'uu mirkaneeffadhaa.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul1: Jalqaba URL irratti mallattoo qufulaa fi HTTPS jiraachuu mirkaneeffadhaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul2: Weebsaayitoota akeekkachiisa nageenyaa kennan daawwachuu irraa of qusadhaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul3: Maqaan doomeenii weebsaayitichaa sirriitti barraa'uu mirkaneeffadhaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul4: Kuukiiwwan qaama sadaffaa hin mirkanoofne daangessaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Desc: Netwoorkii intarneetii ummataa irratti yeroo jirtan of eeggannoo godhaa.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Bul1: Wi-Fi ummataa irratti hojii baankii ykn dhimma iccitii hin hojjetinaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Bul2: Yeroo hunda VPN amansiisaa ta'e fayyadamaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Bul3: Faayilii qooduu fi walqunnamtii ofumaan ta'u cufaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Bul4: Hojii keessan yeroo xumurtan netwoorkicha irraa ba'aa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Desc: Baawuzerii keessan dabalatoota balaa fidan irraa eegaa.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Bul1: Dabalatoota kuusaa amansiisaa fi seera qabeessa qofaa irraa buufadhaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Bul2: Dabalatoota dullooman kan hin fayyadamne haquun baasaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Bul3: Hayyamoota dabalatoonni gaafatan of eeggannoon sakatta'aa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Desc: Mana ykn waajjira keessan ala netwoorkii wajjin yeroo walqunnamtan nagaa ta'aa.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul1: Wi-Fi ummataa irratti akkaawuntiiwwan iccitii banuu irraa of qusadhaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul2: Netwoorkii hin amanamne irratti tajaajila VPN fayyadamaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul3: Bakka ummataatti faayilii qooduu fi AirDrop cufaa
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul4: Ofumaan akka hin deebineef erga fayyadamaniin booda netwoorkicha irraanfadhaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacyDesc: Odeeffannoo iccitii dhuunfaa fi dhaabbataa hateenya irraa eegaa.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Desc: Odeeffannoo eegumsa barbaadan akkamitti akka adda baasan hubadhaa.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul1: Lakkoofsi waraqaa eenyummaa, herregni baankii fi ragaan fayyaa iccitii dha
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul2: Odeeffannoon dhuunfaa hojjettootaa fi maamiltootaa of eeggannoon qabamuu qaba
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul3: Jechootni darbii fi furtuuwwan akka hin mul'anne eegaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul4: Namoonni hayyama hin qabne odeeffannoo iccitii akka hin argine dhowwaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Desc: Faayiloota yeroo qooddan qajeelfama nageenyaa hordofaa.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Bul1: Sanadoota iccitii erguu dura koodii iccitii (Encrypt) itti godhaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Bul2: Faayiloota nama sirriif qofa qooduu keessan mirkaneeffadhaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Bul3: Sanadoota hojii imeelii dhuunfaatiin ykn miidiyaa hawaasaatiin hin qoodinaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Desc: Seera nageenya saayibarii dhaabbata keessanii fi biyya keessanii kabajaa.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul1: Qajeelfamoota fi seerota nageenya saayibarii INSA hordofaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul2: Balaan odeeffannoo yoo mudate battalumatti qaama dhimmi ilaallatutti beeksisaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul3: Leenjii qabiinsa daataa yeroo yeroon fudhadhaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul4: Meeshaalee irratti daataa iccitiin saamsuu (Device Encryption) fayyadamaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Bul2: Hordoffii dhowwuu (Do Not Track) baawuzerii irratti dandeessisaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Bul3: Meeshaalee seenaa barbaacha keessanii hin galmeessine fayyadamaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Bul4: Dhaabbilee akkaawuntii keessanitti dhiyaatan yeroo yeroon sakatta'aa
awarenessData.incidentResponseDesc: Balaan saayibarii yeroo ga'u miidhaa xiqqeessuuf tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa fudhadhaa.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Desc: Meeshaan ykn akkaawuntiin keessan haleelamuu isaa mallattoolee mul'isan beekaa.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul1: Meeshaan tasa haala hin baramneen yeroo suuta jedhu ykn dhaabbatu
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul2: Sagantaaleen ykn faayiloonni ofumaan yeroo banaman
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul3: Ergaawwan hin beekamne akkaawuntii keessan irraa namoota biroof yeroo ergaman
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul4: Jechi darbii keessan akka jijjiirame ykn cufame yeroo argitan
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Desc: Balaan yeroo mudatu miidhaa daangessuuf tarkaanfiiwwan fudhataman.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul1: Meeshicha battalumatti intarneetii fi Wi-Fi irraa addaan kutaa
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul2: Meeshicha guutummaatti hin dhaabsisinaa, qorannoof banaa dhiisaa
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul3: Mallattoolee fi sa'aatii balaan mudate galmeessaa
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul4: Meeshaa biraa fayyadamuun jecha darbii keessan jijjiiraa
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Desc: Balaa mudate INSA ykn garee saayibarii dhaabbata keessaniif beeksisaa.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Bul1: Balaa mudate battalumatti kutaa nageenya saayibariitti gabaasaa
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Bul2: Wanta ta'e hunda ifatti fi sirriitti ibsaa
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Bul4: Hanga qorannoon xumuramutti meeshaicha hin fayyadaminaa
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Desc: Sirna keessan deebisaa fi balaa gara fuulduraa ittisaa.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul1: Meeshaalee miidhaman irratti qorannoo farra-vaayirasii guutuu adeamsisaa
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul2: Daataa kuusaa nageenyi isaa mirkanaa'e irraa deebisaa
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul3: Qindaa'ina nageenyaa akkaawuntiiwwan hunda irratti cimsaa
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul4: Balaa mudate fi barumsa argame galmeessaa
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsDesc: Jireenya dijiitaalaa guyyuu nageenyi isaa akka eegamuuf amaleeffannaa barbaachisaa horadhaa.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Desc: Nageenya meeshaalee fi appilikeeshinoota keessanii yeroon haaromsaa.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Bul1: Haaromsa sirna hojjetu (OS) osoo hin tursiin fe'aa
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Bul3: Appilikeeshinoota dullooman fi hin barbaachisne haquun baasaa
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Bul4: Sooftiweerii farra-vaayirasii keessanii yeroo hunda haaromsaa
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Desc: Odeeffannoon yoo bade salphaatti kan deebifamu ta'uu mirkaneeffadhaa.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Bul1: Seera 3-2-1 hordofaa (koppii 3, miidiyaa 2 irratti, 1 bakka biraatti)
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Bul2: Sanadoota gurguddoo duumessa (Cloud) ykn hard drive irratti olkaayaa
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Bul3: Koppiin olkaa'ame hojjechuu isaa yeroo yeroon qoraa
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Desc: Bilbiloota, laaptooppota fi taableetota sirriitti eegaa.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Bul1: Meeshaalee hunda irratti PIN jabaa ykn baayomeetiriiksii fayyadamaa
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Bul2: Meeshaalee bakka hin beekamnetti to'annoo malee hin dhiisinaa
